title: The dabba never goes back empty.

fallback_files_mr.note: Reader gate: if no Gujarati reader signs off મંગળ on the final PNGs, post these in place of s01 and s03 (seal script मंगळ) and end the caption 'Happy Diwali. Today's mangal: Marathi, मंगळ.' s02 carries no seal and does not change.

caption:
Every Indian kitchen has one rule. The dabba never goes back empty.

Faral arrives at the door all week. B-204's dabba goes back with ruby-red huggies inside. Good luck to whoever has to return it next.

Baguette Huggies, ₹1,199 a pair, in four colours, and a match for the Ruby Baguette Tennis Bracelet. Shown larger on the dabba; each huggie is about 15mm across. Take any 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off (a pair of huggies counts as one piece). Your bag applies the code, BUY2 or BUY3, by itself.

Happy Diwali. Today's mangal: Gujarati, મંગળ.

[ baguette huggies · 18k gold tone plated · your move ]
first_comment: Tag the neighbour whose dabba is still in your kitchen. #NairaFlore #HappyDiwali #DiwaliFaral #HuggieEarrings #DemiFineJewellery
alt_text: On a bottle-green ground, a drawn steel dabba engraved Mrs. Joshi, B-204, standing open, its steel lid leaning against it. A real pair of gold tone huggie hoops, each set with one row of ruby-red baguette stones, sits in its mouth: one hoop stands on the front rim, the other lies just inside. Text: House rule N° 05, Diwali. The dabba never goes back empty. It came with chakli. It goes back with this. Naira, Mangal, and mangal in Gujarati script, beside a small steel key.

A close-up of one Ruby Baguette Huggie lying on a cream plaster block: six ruby-red baguette stones in gold tone claws along its front, the rest of the hoop plain polished gold tone. Text: One row of ruby-red. Baguettes crosswise along the lower front, plain gold tone above. Ruby-red cubic zirconia, about 15mm across, hinged snap. Baguette Huggies, Ruby, ₹1,199. 18K gold tone plated.

Four drawn steel dabbas seen from above on a bottle-green ground, each with a pair of Baguette Huggies centred on its lid, labelled ruby, crystal, green and amethyst. Text: Four dabbas. Four stones. One for every neighbour who sent faral. Baguette Huggies, cubic zirconia, ₹1,199 a pair. Naira, Mangal, and mangal in Gujarati script, beside a small steel key.
